description: Writes again the messages of the people of ONE campaign that are from an earlier version of its template (messagesOutdated), the "Reescrever as N" action. One run, only those people: sent messages and hand-edited ones stay. It is refused in the same request that changed the template. Free. Nothing is sent. Returns how many were rewritten, or that the rest is still being written.
name: rewrite_campaign_messages
title: Reescrever as mensagens da campanha
